title: A great experience

author: Tobylerone89

title: Great experience!
text: Informative and a great tasting! Our guide was super knowledgeable and fun. Great tour if you like manufacturing and a good beer!
author: Melinda_A

title: Fun, fascinating, full of flavor!
text: Really great in-depth experience for those interested in the process of brewing and also distribution from start to finish and everything in between! Well-curated tasting of both popular and niche cutting-edge craft brews. Excellent hospitality. 10/10 would recommend.
author: Christopher_P

title: Modern beer tasting experience
text: This tour is one and a half hours. Five euro cheaper than Central historic brewery. Clean, super modern and a knowledgeable friendly guide. The scale and precision is impressive. From the forty beers that they brew, you have five selected styles to taste at the end, well worth the effort to book.
author: 595craigd

title: Fantastic tour and beer tasting
text:
The tour was really good and one of the best brewery tours I have ever been on. An expert takes you on the tour and you can see the factory in action. As there is an expert there, you can ask any questions you may have. Only negative which was our own fault, was that we chose to do the tour on a Spanish bank holiday so the factory wasn’t in action!

author: jakehH1672VF

title: Good experience
text:
Enjoyed this experience, was something different to do. 

We went on a Saturday as that was the only day for English tour, the tour guide was very knowledgeable and friendly. 

I don’t like beer but the tasting was worth the money to try 5 different beers!

Be aware in quieter season the factory is operating on weekend so when we went we saw the factory but not in action.
